Package de.hof.dms.dto

Record Class AclDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.hof.dms.dto.AclDto
Record Components:
owner - the id of the resource owner
ownerDepartment - the owning department
allowedUserIds - the user ids granted access
allowedRoles - the roles granted access
allowedDepartments - the departments granted access
access - the effective permission flags
inheritFromParent - whether the ACL is inherited from the parent
public record AclDto(String owner, String ownerDepartment, List<String> allowedUserIds, List<String> allowedRoles, List<String> allowedDepartments, AccessDto access, boolean inheritFromParent) extends Record
API-layer view of a FolderAcl: owner, owning department, the allowed user/role/department lists, the effective AccessDto flags and the inheritFromParent switch. Mapped to/from the domain object via from(FolderAcl) and toAcl(); used when reading or updating folder/document permissions.
